evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in the posterior horn of medial meniscus extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
evidence.Medial OA: Wearing of articular cartilage of left knee (especially at medial femoral condyle and patellofemoral joint) with mild subchondral bone marrow edema over medial tibial plateau and trochlea; osteophytes formation also noted, reflecting osteoarthritis.
evidence.PF OA: Wearing of articular cartilage of left knee (especially at medial femoral condyle and patellofemoral joint) with mild subchondral bone marrow edema over medial tibial plateau and trochlea; osteophytes formation also noted, reflecting osteoarthritis.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Baker's: A small lobulated cystic lesion in the medial popliteal fossa between the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the tendon of semimembranosus, in favor of Baker's cyst.
evidence.Contusion: mild subchondral bone marrow edema over medial tibial plateau and trochlea; osteophytes formation also noted, reflecting osteoarthritis.
